Change connection target
Manual targets never fall back. If the selected build is unavailable, PCM and clipboard bridge requests fail.
Auto prefers BiBi Keyboard Pro and falls back to the open-source build. Manual Pro or open-source targets do not fall back.
Show recording area
Inject the waveform and recording area into hooked keyboards.
Stops injecting the waveform and recording area. Text insertion, IME visibility, and clipboard bridging stay available.
Shows the waveform and recording area at the bottom of hooked keyboards. Changes apply the next time the keyboard window is shown.
Show waveform only while recording
Hide the idle waveform without disabling the recording area.
Keeps the waveform visible while idle and recording.
Hides the waveform while idle. The recording area stays active, and the waveform appears during recording. Changes apply the next time the keyboard window is shown.
Tap to start and stop recording
Use two taps instead of holding the recording area.
Hold the recording area to start, then release to finish. Moving outside the area cancels recording.
Tap once to start recording and tap again to finish. Changes apply the next time the keyboard window is shown.
